assessment.question:
### Exercise 17.5: Find the mode of a data set

3. Find the mode of the following set of measurements:

$$
\text{ 4 m; 7 m; 6 m; 11 m; 8 m; 5 m; 9 m; 6 m; 11 m}
$$
assessment.expected_answer:
Sorted data:

$$
\text{4 m; 5 m; 6 m; 6 m; 7 m; 8 m; 9 m; 11 m; 11 m}
$$

The modes are 6 m and 11 m.
